A stalker threatens to harm Flex.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E11 — Santa's Got a Brand New Bag
Mark and Geneva are saddened when Nicole stops believing in Santa. Then a mysterious cousin visits, who knows how to make Nicole happy.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E12 — Private School
Mark is assigned to teach Black history at an expensive private school for one week. When the principal offers him a job at a much higher salary, Mark has a big decision to make.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E13 — For Whom the Heck the Bell Tolls
Not wanting to admit that he can't remember a recently deceased basketball coach, Mark agrees to give the eulogy at his funeral.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E14 — It's My Party and I'll Die If I Want to
It is almost Mark's 30th birthday, and Tyler discovers a lump on Mark. After a misunderstanding with his doctor, Mark thinks that he is dying so he goes skydiving and gives away his stuff.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E15 — The Courtship of Mark Cooper
Mark is in the midst of defending himself in court when he realizes the plaintiff's lawyer is an ex-girlfriend he dumped brutally.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E16 — Wedding Bell Blues
When Mark's demanding employer, P.J., tells him she is going to marry her old boyfriend and quit her job, Mark has to decide if he should tell her a secret that could make her cancel the wedding. Queen Latifah guest stars and sings "Just Another Day.".

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E17 — Truth or Consequences
Mark and Vanessa make a bet on who can go the longest without telling a lie.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E18 — Trading Places
When Vanessa applies for a job at a conservative Christian radio station, she tells the manager that Mark is her husband and Geneva is her wild cousin.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E6 — Labels
Hakeem’s cousin transfers to their school and Moesha goes out with him.

title: Moesha
description:

Moesha is off visiting cousins out of town.  Meanwhile, Dee thinks Frank is spending too much time with “the boys” including his brother Bernie.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E8 — Ichi, Ni, San, Shi Look-Clarkzilla
Frank’s nephew (Mo’s cousin) is the family’s “bad seed” and no one likes him around.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E9 — A Concerted Effort (Part 1)
Mo cries the lovesick blues on a phone-in radio show.  The DJ, feeling sorry for Mo, gives her four free tickets to an upcoming concert.

description:

Although he is supposed to be home watching Drew and Tonya, Chris sneaks out to go to the movies with his friends and witnesses a shoot-out outside the theater.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:

Chris is just starting to fit in at his new high school when he gets asked on a date by the dorkiest girl in school, Kelly, whom everyone calls 'Big Bird.'.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:

Julius realizes that the key to keeping Rochelle happy in their marriage is getting advice from 'The Oprah Winfrey Show.' Unfortunately, the plan backfires when Rochelle equates Julius' new attitude with an extramarital affair.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E10 — Everybody Hates Mr. Levine
When Rochelle orders a copy of her birth certificate, she realizes that she is actually one year younger than she thought she was and decides to start living her life with a new, younger attitude.

title: Half & Half
description:

Dee Dee starts dating a guy who, as it turns out, was Mona’s ex-high school boyfriend and her first.

title: Half & Half
description:

Mona and Dee Dee’s relationship gets sticky when Mona accuses Dee Dee of trying to change her just to fit in with her upscale group of friends.

title: Half & Half
description:

Big Dee Dee and Dee Dee jump through hoops on Thanksgiving to please Grandma Thorne (Carroll), who plays favorites with Phyllis and Mona.

title: Half & Half
description:

When Mona and Dee Dee set Spencer up on blind dates, Spencer falls for her hard and fast.

description:

Mark tries to help Geneva's boyfriend become a part of his group of male friends with disastrous results. Nicole hides a stray cat in her room, but Vanessa is allergic to cats.

description:

It looks like Mark, Geneva and Vanessa may all be leaving Oakland forever due to some unexpected surprises--good and bad--in this season finale cliffhanger.

Mark becomes the faculty advisor for a student military program and learns that war games are no fun.

When Mark injures himself, Vanessa proves her medical skills.

Nicole dares Tyler to stay all night in a haunted house on Halloween.Halloween episode.

description:

Nicole feels guilty about lying and learns a lesson from a dream. Professional basketball player JULIUS "DR. J" ERVING guest stars as himself.
